reason: A pure-prompt Agent Skills pack primarily focused on generating and processing project documentation, with related pull request and code review assistance; the README states it works offline with no third-party dependencies.

summaries.zh: 一个基于纯提示词的文档处理技能包，可根据代码库和 Git 历史生成 README、PR 描述、changelog，并提供结构化代码审查意见。
summaries.en: A prompt-based document processing skill pack that generates README files, pull request descriptions, and changelogs from project evidence while also providing structured code review opinions.

capabilities: Generates or rewrites README content from a codebase
Generates pull request descriptions from diffs and commit history
Categorizes and rewrites git history into changelogs
Reads codebase files and git history through the harness
